test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: Who founded the Indian Statistical Institute on 17 December 1931?
solution:
__
 
• Indian Statistical Institute was founded by **Professor P.C. Mahalanobis**__ on 17th December 1931.
 
• Headquarters: **Kolkata**.
 
• Indian Statistical Institute has the status of an Institution of National Importance. This status was given by an act of the **Indian Parliament in 1959.**
 
• Statistics, natural sciences and social sciences are main areas of research.
